description.zh: AutoComplete 页面显示组件标题、用途说明、导入代码和 Features 区域，左侧同组目录中也标出 AutoComplete。 Aeris UI 是给 Angular 22 用的无障碍组件库，首屏自己标了 alpha、不适合生产。它列出 82 个组件、WCAG 2.2 AA、明暗主题、RTL 就绪与可摇树入口，整库 MIT 开源。
description.en: Aeris UI 是给 Angular 22 用的无障碍组件库，首屏自己标了 alpha、不适合生产。它列出 82 个组件、WCAG 2.2 AA、明暗主题、RTL 就绪与可摇树入口，整库 MIT 开源。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Aeris UI (https://aeris-ui.dev/).
Technology stack: angular.
Component specification: AutoComplete 页面显示组件标题、用途说明、导入代码和 Features 区域，左侧同组目录中也标出 AutoComplete。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏左上角写 Aeris UI v22.0.0-alpha.7 与一枚 ALPHA Not production ready 标签，大标题 Build interfaces that stay coherent.，右侧是一张活组件面板 Create a workspace，字段有 Workspace name、Workspace type、Weekly summary，底部写 Alex Mason will be the owner 和 Create workspace 按钮。标题下压着一段黄色警告：Alpha software. Aeris is under active development and is not production ready.。安装框给 ng add @aeris-ui/core@22.0.0-alpha.7，带 Guided 与 Package only 两个标签页和一个 Copy 按钮。首屏底部并排六枚 chip：82 components、WCAG 2.2 AA、Signal-first APIs、Light and dark themes、RTL ready、Tree-shakable entry points。导航只有 Guides、Components、Design Lab，Guides 下分 installation、accessibility、theming、framework-compatibility。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
